bio_en: Minas Tolpashian, known as Gayl ('Wolf') Vahan, was born in 1872 in Havav, a village of Palu, and learned little more than reading and writing before leaving at 15-16 to work in Constantinople, where by 1889 he was a carpenter under his brother. He emigrated to America, and in Providence, disillusioned with the Hnchaks, joined the ARF, impatient with mere drill and eager to enter the homeland. He crossed the border many times and in 1904 commanded the 'Masis' band in the Mosun expedition in Bagrevand. Surrounded with his forty men, he and his band died heroically there.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death in the Mosun and Zor expedition of 1904 per #23 and #96.
